print_setup.orientation: neutral pose, Z vertical, all four components start at Z=0

checks.name: OpenSCAD CGAL render
checks.details: Assembly and each part selector rendered as a simple 3D object.

checks.name: STL topology
checks.details: model.stl contains 4 watertight connected components. Each parts_N.stl contains exactly one watertight component. The four part volumes sum to the assembly volume within STL rounding.

checks.name: Envelope
checks.details: Measured bounds are 84.05 x 34.40 x 8.65 mm, below 100 x 50 x 60 mm.

checks.name: Joint dimensions
checks.details: Pin radius 1.8 mm and bore radius 2.3 mm give 0.5 mm one-sided radial clearance. Flange and chamber radii 3.1 mm and 3.7 mm give 0.6 mm clearance. Axial gaps and conical capture shoulders are modeled explicitly.

checks.name: Neutral component separation
checks.details: The assembly STL has four separate shells in the common coordinate frame: one fixed body and three tail segments.

checks.name: Motion envelope geometry sample
checks.details: For each joint, adjacent-part horizontal cross-sections were sampled at 21 angles from -20 to +20 degrees in 2-degree steps and 14 Z levels. No cross-section overlap was found. This is a geometric sample, not a physical articulation test or a full continuous 3D collision proof.

checks.name: No-support slicing
checks.details: PrusaSlicer 2.7.2 exported G-code using the supplied PLA 0.20 mm no-support profile. The slicer reported Floating bridge anchors, Low bed adhesion, and Loose extrusions, and suggested supports and a brim. No supports were enabled, so no support material occupies the joint gaps.

limitations: Support-free print reliability is not established. Although a no-support G-code export completed and the captive geometry is present, PrusaSlicer reports floating bridge anchors, loose extrusions, and low bed adhesion. A physical print is needed to confirm that all three joints separate and move freely without fused clearances or broken features.
The declared and geometrically sampled range is at least +/-20 degrees. The design has no hard angular stops, so travel beyond this range and its collision limits are not characterized.

The 0.5 mm radial pin clearance and 0.6 mm flange clearance are nominal CAD values. PLA dimensional error, first-layer expansion, flow calibration, and printer-specific cooling can reduce effective clearance.
